name: Jotform
description: Jotform forms and their submissions, with a read-only scope on offer.
long_description:
Jotform's hosted server. It lists forms, reads submissions and reports, and can create a form.

Its authorization server offers a `readOnly` scope beside `full`, which is the one to pick when the chat is only meant to read.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Jotform in your browser. This entry asks for the `readOnly` scope; `full` exists if you need writing.

risk.notes: Reads your forms and the answers people sent them.
